title: Padise Abbey
geometryBasis: Named survey outline and open courts, the abbey exhibition's documented range layout, and three exact public-domain Qualla originals.
sectionBasis: The northern church range and surviving corner turret sit above the cloister ranges, with roofed western and north volumes, lower irregular walls and the open inner and outer courts. The restored abbey uses pale protective sheet roofing and timber structures.
limitations: The present conservation state is represented by the documented roof additions, open courts and extant walls. Precise wall profiles, the lesser openings and surviving chamber heights are approximated.
Scope follows the mapped abbey enclosure. The separate manor and outlying structures beyond the abbey are excluded.
